entry.title: a small guide to api design
entry.content:
I keep coming back to api design, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Api design shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: api design in practice
entry.content:
Every few months api design bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Api design shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: what i learned about api design
entry.content:
Every few months api design bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Api design shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
